TEXAS WATER DEVELOPMENT BOARD
MEMBERS 
JAMES M ROSE
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR
A L. BLACK, CHAIRMAN
ROBERT B. GILMORE. VICE CHAIRMAN DALLAS
MILTON T. POTTS
JOHN H GARRETT
GEORGE W. McCLESKEY
GLEN E RONEY
P.O. BOX 13087 CAPITOL STATION AUSTIN, TEXAS 78711
May 6, 1976
AREA CODE 512 475 3187 1700 NORTH CONGRESS AVENUE
IN REPLY REFER TO
TWDBP 
Mr. J.L. Johnson, P.E. Acting Chief, Engineering Division Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers P.O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Johnson:
Please refer to your letter of April 22, 1976 regarding the possible addition of two hydroelectric generators to the International Amistad Lake Project.
This agency has no specific land use plans in the affected project area; however, we are quite interested in the impact of installation of two generators in Amistad Dam, and releases of water for power-generation purposes, on the overall water situation in the Rio Grande Basin.
In order for us to assess the possible environmental impact of the proposed project, and determine whether or not information in our files would be beneficial to your planning, we will need additional information. It would be helpful to know whether a power pool is to be established in the lake. Will the flood control pool be altered? Have studies progressed to the point where changes in the release pattern can be projected and the maximum release rate for power generation determined? Can the river stage at various downstream points be projected, at this time, for various power release rates?
I look forward to hearing from you on these matters. Thank you for advising us of your studies.
Sincerely,
outies III. Hose
